turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Hi. I’ve had a cough, and my nose or the back of my throat feels itchy. My eyes also itch a lot—like one or both eyes—and it’s been bothering me.
[ASK] Do you have **chest pain that is worse with breathing in (pleuritic pain)** or **sudden shortness of breath**?
No, I don’t have chest pain when I breathe in. And I don’t have sudden shortness of breath.
[ASK] Does the patient have **fever** (or documented elevated temperature) along with **upper respiratory symptoms** (e.g., sore throat, runny nose, cough)?
No fever. I just have the cough and itchy nose/throat, and my eyes itch too.
[ASK] Do you have **chest pain/pressure that is triggered by exertion or stress and improves with rest**?
No. My symptoms are not like chest pain with running or stress, and they don’t get better when I rest.
[ASK] Does the patient have **fever** (or chills) **and** a **cough** (or shortness of breath)?
No fever or chills. Just the cough.
[ASK] Do you have muscle weakness that worsens with use and improves with rest (e.g., drooping eyelids, difficulty swallowing)?
No, I don’t have muscle weakness or drooping eyelids or trouble swallowing.
[ASK] Did the patient have sudden onset of rapid, irregular heartbeat (palpitations) without an obvious allergic trigger?
No, I don’t have palpitations or a rapid, irregular heartbeat.

[ASK] Did the symptoms start suddenly within minutes to a few hours after eating fish or other high-risk food (e.g., tuna/mackerel) and include flushing, hives, or a “peppery”/burning taste in the mouth?
No. It didn’t start after eating fish or any high-risk food, and I don’t have flushing, hives, or a peppery/burning taste.
[ASK] Do you have a painful bulge or swelling in the groin (especially worse when coughing or standing)?
No, I don’t have any painful bulge or swelling in my groin.
